paragraphs: Aun bar Imi — Shabbat, chapter 6, halakhah 5; R’ Tachlifa bar Imi — Maaserot, chapter 4, halakhah 3; Rabbi Yaakov bar Imi — Ketubot, beginning of chapter 6.[^1]

notes.text: Guggenheimer Shabbat 6:5 reads Anan with the sequence כר׳ אימי, beside Hyman’s Aun bar Imi; no parentage repair is made. The Maasrot 4:3 paragraph writes Rav Tachlifa bar Imi, beside Hyman’s abbreviated title, here retained as R’. Ketubot 6:1 fully writes Rabbi Yaakov bar Imi. These three pointers do not identify a common father.
